theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)) (z : Euclid P) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → μ (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ 0 → μ (ball z (2 * r)) ≠ ∞ → μ₀ = ENNReal.ofReal (r⁻¹ ^ n) • (μ.restrict (ball z (2 * r))).map (dilation z r) → μ₀ univ ≠ 0 ∧ μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ ∧ μ₀ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 2)ᶜ = 0 ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (lam : ℝ), 0 < lam → (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) univ ≠ 0 ∧ (ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam)) univ ≠ ∞
